residual_closure_set.producer_binding: Gate1 input must equal the actual product-value-gated candidate count. The actual enrichment queue plus that count must equal raw discovery.
residual_closure_set.consumer_binding: The Safe/Review/Hard Block partition must equal gated input. Explicit contract fields are all required and safe nonnegative integers. Legacy receipts retain the original raw-discovery partition semantics.

required_preflight: Re-read original run as terminal cancelled; do not rerun it.
Re-read merged PR, original exact head/base/tree and ordered merge parents.
Bind current protected main as a descendant of the original merge and bind the recovery implementation to its exact SHA.
Read original reservation consistently and existing receipt objects before any write.
Preserve the original nonce/generation and original reservation owner in recovery history.
Require fresh cryptographically verified, distinct three-role approvals scoped only to terminal recovery; never renew or impersonate the expired original approvals.
Use the existing approved workload identities and finalizer signing key; provisioning credentials must not manufacture role signatures.
Perform one atomic fenced reservation transition bound to original owner/head/state and elected recovery run, with replay/conflict rejection.
Allow consumption and immutable receipt sealing only; prohibit PR merge, Ready transition and new landing authorization.
Read back the consumed reservation, immutable object version/checksum/retention and exact-main receipt bindings before declaring recovery verified.

residual_closure_set.proposed_action: Reconcile the stored bootstrap template with exact-main desired template while preserving current effective IAM scope and OIDC trust.

autonomous_effect: Remove the demonstrated cardinality failure without manual run substitution; define bounded original-reservation recovery.
global_effect: Retain all observed discovery candidates and explicitly account for the enrichment queue without admitting new providers.
irreplaceable_value_effect: Preserve owned candidate identity, original authorization lineage and immutable terminal evidence.
transparency_effect: Keep local draft, planned recovery and external deployed evidence distinct; do not claim complete closure.
